result.brief: 提出扩散 U-Net 自表征对齐损失，将高噪声浅层表征对齐到低噪声深层表征，并结合跨注意力实现视频条件背景音乐生成。
result.reason: Aligns internal diffusion U-Net representations across noise levels and generates symbolic music conditioned on video, matching video-related audio generation; representation alignment is only internal to the diffusion model.
